scenario: 2025 Copenhagen boundary conditions: observed DK2 prices and DMI weather

provenance.price_data: Energinet DK2 historical wholesale day-ahead prices
provenance.ambient_data: DMI observed station air temperature (with explicit gap flags)

illustrative_size_optimum.warning: Grid search under hypothetical linear CAPEX; not an equipment recommendation

metrics.data_provenance: electricity: Energinet observed; ambient: DMI observed with QC flags; district heat demand and technology parameters: assumed
metrics.counterfactual: district heat supplied by natural gas boiler; no heat-recovery infrastructure
metrics.note: Illustrative feasibility study, not a bankable feasibility assessment.

limitations: IT load, thermal demand coefficients, capture fraction and plant parameters are assumptions; weather and market prices are observed ONLY when supplied
The COP relation is a parametric approximation, not a measured heat-pump curve
PUE is background electricity only and is not counted as recovered heat
Counterfactual assumes marginal heat supplied by a gas boiler
Emissions are operational and conditional on assumed grid/boiler factors
No thermal storage, hydraulic network model, redundancy or heat-exchanger sizing
Real-capex, tax and tariff quotations are not available
